items.question: How is śaktipāta distinguished by reasoning and scripture?
premises: Such mind incapable of touching truth is seen in these.
Even buddhas like Brahma and Vishnu speak thus.
items.inference: Śaktipāta is classified through reason and scripture.
uncertainties: sandhi split tathāvidhām eva; dṛṣṭvā eṣām
items.plain_english: Seeing such a mind incapable of touching truth among these, even buddhas like Brahma and Vishnu speak thus; therefore this śaktipāta is distinguished by reasoning and scripture.

items.question: How is śaktipāta distinguished by reasoning and scripture?
premises: Thus this power-descent is distinguished by reasoning and scripture.
items.inference: Śaktipāta is classified through reason and scripture.
items.plain_english: Thus this śaktipāta is distinguished by reasoning and scripture.
